guide.templenihility.page.0.title: Codex of Nihility
guide.templenihility.page.0.body:
The in-game guide to Temple of Nihility.

Start with three actions: find a temple, collect Stillstone and Void Crystal, then follow the altar diagrams.

Craft: book + Stillstone, Nihility Shard, or Erasure Dust.
guide.templenihility.page.1.title: Progression
guide.templenihility.page.1.body:
1. Find an Overworld temple.
2. Gather stone, crystal, and shards.
3. Craft runes and Nihility armor.
4. Use the armor to gain Nihility Energy.
5. Upgrade the Erasure Altar.
6. Build vault and energy infrastructure.
7. Advance through high-tier trades and rituals.
guide.templenihility.page.2.title: Natural Temples
guide.templenihility.page.2.body:
Temples generate across most Overworld land biomes above Y=60.

Shrines have an open approach, tier-I altar, and cache. A medium temple has an entrance, trade hall, supply archive, and tier-II ritual hall.

A Temple Complex has a central tier-III sanctum, west vault hall, east energy-transfer hall, north guarded court, and south approach. Use: /locate structure templenihility:nihility_temple
guide.templenihility.page.3.title: First Resources
guide.templenihility.page.3.body:
Peaceful start: mine Stillstone from a shrine and smelt it into Nihility Dust. Any altar turns 8 Dust into 1 Nihility Shard, so neutral residents do not need to be attacked.

Shrine caches hold starter materials; medium archives have richer supplies; the Complex's north relic cache may hold Crystals, Relic Fragments, or a Nihility Core.

Opening guarded containers alerts nearby denizens. Residents still trade on right-click and drop extra tiered materials when defeated.
guide.templenihility.page.4.title: Erasure Altar
guide.templenihility.page.4.body:
All components sit on the same Y level in a maximum 5x5 footprint.

An unformed altar only handles the free dust upgrade. Tier I unlocks crystal and rune steps, Tier II seals and cores, and Tier III resonance and relic conversion.

Right-click to inspect the tier and missing parts.

guide.templenihility.page.7.title: Running A Ritual
guide.templenihility.page.7.body:
Right-click the altar and place material in the left input slot. The lower status line shows output, quantity, minimum structure, and Nihility Energy.

With a clear output slot, press Ritual. Success spends material and player energy together and places the result on the right.

Failures explain the exact blockage and do not consume input.
guide.templenihility.page.8.title: Ritual Progression I
guide.templenihility.page.8.body:
Unformed: 8 Erasure Dust -> 1 Nihility Shard, 0 energy.

Tier I: 4 Shards -> 1 Void Crystal, 3 energy.

Tier I: 4 Void Crystals -> 1 Temple Rune, 6 energy.

Nihility Energy is stored on the player, not inside the altar.
guide.templenihility.page.9.title: Ritual Progression II
guide.templenihility.page.9.body:
Tier II: 4 Runes -> 1 Temple Seal, 10 energy.
Tier II: 4 Seals -> 1 Nihility Core, 16 energy.

Tier III: 4 Cores -> 1 Chaos Resonance Core, 24 energy.
Tier III: 8 Temple Relic Fragments -> 1 Seal, 20 energy.
guide.templenihility.page.10.title: Creatures And Trade
guide.templenihility.page.10.body:
Five tiers: Believer, Follower, Envoy, Grand Envoy, and Saint. All begin neutral and trade on right-click.

Attacks or guarded loot trigger alert and group retaliation.

Believers avoid sprints. The next three pages explain the combat roles.
guide.templenihility.page.16.title: Grand Envoy
guide.templenihility.page.16.body:
Domain: radius 9 for 12 seconds. Sprinting is slowed; teleports cost 10 extra energy.

Recall: moves up to 3 engaged allies to safe nearby spaces.

Shield: 3 nodes at low health. Each lowers one successful hit to 45% damage.
guide.templenihility.page.17.title: Saint Duel
guide.templenihility.page.17.body:
Use Duel at a tier-III altar within 24 blocks. After 3 seconds, only you can hurt the Saint.

Stay within 28 blocks for up to 4 minutes. Press Exit or leave to withdraw.

Win: +1 Nihility Core and +2 Temple Relic Fragments.
guide.templenihility.page.18.title: Guard And Rift
guide.templenihility.page.18.body:
Follower: within 6 blocks, absorbs one projectile aimed at a lower ally at half health; 12-second cooldown.

Envoy: reflects one projectile every 6 seconds.

Rift Direction has a 12-tick warning and moves the target only to a safe side space.
guide.templenihility.page.19.title: Saint Attacks
guide.templenihility.page.19.body:
Erasure Line locks one pale path for 20 ticks. It does not track you; step sideways. A hit deals 14 damage.

Deal 4+ damage to the Saint during the warning to interrupt it.
guide.templenihility.page.20.title: Missing Zones
guide.templenihility.page.20.body:
Three circles warn for 16 ticks, then last 6 seconds.

Standing inside pushes you outward and deals 4 damage each second.

The zones never delete or replace blocks. Deal 4+ damage during the warning to interrupt them.
guide.templenihility.page.11.title: Void Vault
guide.templenihility.page.11.body:
Same-owner vaults connect across all six adjacent directions. Each starts at 243 slots and reaches 972 after three upgrades.

The terminal groups identical items into one entry and supports scrolling, search, name/count/mod sorting, and 3x3 crafting.

Sneak-use a terminal on a vault to bind it; O opens it by default. Protection and chunk loading are configured inside.
guide.templenihility.page.12.title: Nihility Energy
guide.templenihility.page.12.body:
A full Nihility armor set gains 1 energy each second. Attacks spend 1 energy for a 25% dodge chance, and the set repairs one Nihility item by 1 durability each second.

Prisms generate 2 energy per exposed air face; Energy Cells store 10000.

Place a Transport Core between two containers and right-click to choose input/output faces and resource mode. It supports combined priority, nine item allow/deny filters, and redstone control. The top status explains empty input, missing interfaces, filter rejection, or a blocked output.
guide.templenihility.page.13.title: Actions And Phasing
guide.templenihility.page.13.body:
Ruin Dagger: right-click Missing Step. It can cross intervening walls but only lands in valid empty space.
Zero Blade: hold right-click, then release Zero Slash.
Boundary Greatblade: right-click its three-wave Boundary Break.

Into Nihility ends when you attack; Melt into Nihility lasts for its duration. Both grant invisibility, flight, and phasing. Hidden in Nihility only blocks environmental harm. See item tooltips for exact values.
guide.templenihility.page.14.title: Dependencies
guide.templenihility.page.14.body:
JEI: %s. It shows normal recipes and integrates with terminal search.

Waystones: %s. When present, the Void Warp Stone removes hold time and cooldown and spends Nihility Energy.

Curios: %s. It is required and provides accessory slots, the terminal, and energy accessories.
guide.templenihility.page.15.title: Troubleshooting
guide.templenihility.page.15.body:
Altar inactive: read the material, tier, energy, and output status line.

Terminal will not open: sneak-use it on the vault again and stay in the same dimension.

Vault cannot be mined: disable break protection in its screen.

Prism has no output: expose at least one face directly to air.

Transport stopped: right-click the core and verify input/output faces, resource mode, filter, and redstone. The top line reports the exact blockage.
